title: From network pharmacology to experimental verification: Angelica sinensis and its key constituent beta‑sitosterol exert anti‑liver cancer effects through the p53 signaling pathway.
authors: Du, Ying; Song, Yang; Fan, Yuting; Li, Weitong; Zhang, Yuxin; Shen, Haotian; Tang, Bin; Wang, Jinhui; Deng, Fengmei; Cheng, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学、分子对接和MD模拟研究当归及β-谷甾醇经p53通路抗肝癌，虽含蛋白-小分子对接模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题关联微弱。
abstract: Liver cancer remains a major cause of cancer mortality and the limited benefit of existing therapies leaves a clear need for new therapeutic agents. Although Angelica sinensis (AS) shows broad antitumor potential, its mechanistic basis against liver cancer remains unclear. The present study revealed that AS reduced the viability, proliferation and migration of the HepG2 human liver cancer cell line. Network pharmacology pointed to several putative targets including insulin, peroxisome proliferator‑activated receptor gamma, nuclear factor kappaB subunit 1, estrogen receptor 1 and albumin. By combining molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation and Cell Counting Kit‑8 cell viability screening, beta‑sitosterol (BS) was identified from the candidate compounds of AS for further study, based on its stable interactions with central targets and its strong antiproliferative activity against HepG2 cells in vitro. Mechanistic assays of BS revealed that its anti‑liver cancer effect was mediated through the p53 pathway. BS treatment increased the proportion of apoptotic cells, together with increased expression of the tumor suppressor protein p53 and the pro‑apoptotic proteins Bax and Caspase‑3, and reduced expression of the anti‑apoptotic protein Bcl‑2. Co‑treatment with pifithrin‑alpha hydrobromide, a p53 inhibitor, partly reduced the proportion of apoptotic cells and partly reversed these changes in protein expression, confirming a p53‑dependent mechanism. The present study clarified the mechanisms by which AS, and its active component BS, suppress the proliferation and migration of liver cancer cells and trigger apoptosis through the modulation of the p53 pathway. These results support AS and BS as promising leads for development of plant‑derived therapies against liver cancer.
abstract_zh: 肝癌仍然是癌症死亡的主要原因，现有疗法的获益有限，因此迫切需要新的治疗药物。尽管当归（Angelica sinensis, AS）显示出广泛的抗肿瘤潜力，但其对抗肝癌的机制基础仍不清楚。本研究揭示，AS降低了人肝癌细胞系HepG2的活力、增殖和迁移。网络药理学指出了几个潜在靶点，包括胰岛素、过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ、核因子κB亚基1、雌激素受体1和白蛋白。通过结合分子对接、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和Cell Counting Kit‑8细胞活力筛选，从AS的候选化合物中鉴定出β-谷甾醇（beta-sitosterol, BS）以供进一步研究，这是基于其与核心靶点的稳定相互作用及其在体外对HepG2细胞的强抗增殖活性。对BS的机制研究表明，其抗肝癌效应是通过p53通路介导的。BS处理增加了凋亡细胞的比例，同时提高了肿瘤抑制蛋白p53和促凋亡蛋白Bax及Caspase‑3的表达，并降低了抗凋亡蛋白Bcl‑2的表达。与p53抑制剂pifithrin-alpha hydrobromide共处理部分降低了凋亡细胞的比例，并部分逆转了这些蛋白表达的变化，从而确认了p53依赖性机制。本研究阐明了AS及其活性成分BS通过调节p53通路抑制肝癌细胞增殖和迁移并触发凋亡的机制。这些结果支持AS和BS作为开发植物来源抗肝癌疗法的有前景的先导物。
